notes: A .NET project with only a .csproj (no packages.lock.json). 4DA does not resolve NuGet versions, and before audit A2 (2026-10-12) this project was not reported at all, so it read as having no dependencies. It must be an explicit, counted unsupported file, never a silent drop. Both pinned packages have published advisories (Newtonsoft.Json 12.0.1, System.Text.Encodings.Web 4.5.0), which is why a clean answer here would be wrong.
